title: One Single Deep Bidirectional LSTM Network for Word Sense Disambiguation of Text Data
question: How many layers does their model have?
correct_answer: 6 layers: a sigmoid layer (top), a fully-connected layer, a concatenation layer, a BLSTM layer, a cosine layer, and a sense and word embeddings layer (bottom).
